newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo leads UK drug sector higher.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo leads UK drug sector higher.

text.p: Glaxo Wellcome Plc led major UK drug shares higher on Tuesday, bolstered by a report that U.S. approval for a new anti-depressant could come within weeks, dealers said.
Glaxo shares were up 19p to 1212-1/2 at 0806 GMT. They rose within 1/8p of their peak earlier, after their ADRs climbed to a new high on Monday.
Shares in Zeneca Group Plc were up 25-1/2p to 1898-1/2, while shares in SmithKline Beecham Plc lagged, adding 4-1/2p to 1000.

The Wall Street Journal reported that Glaxo's Zyban, an anti-depressant that has helped smokers quit in clinical trials, could get final approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration within the next few weeks.
